areas.notes: numbers.json claims a fixed follow offset (0, 3.2, -6.5), FOV 50 and a +1 m look target, but the framing changes a lot between shots. start_01 is a high, distant view (the Professor is about 10% of frame height, low centre). crab_defeated_01 is steep and nearly top-down. In key_carried_01 and zone_complete_01 the Professor is far down the tunnel, roughly 8-10 m away, and zone_complete_01 is yawed off-axis. A 6.5 m-back, 3.2 m-up follow would keep him large and constant. The tunnel ring frames fill and block the frame edges in key_carried, level_end and end_state. The numbers contradict the images.

Exposure is usable and nothing is crushed or black. Specular is low, as required. The tunnel glass reads as flat, near-overexposed light-blue panels with jagged sawtooth edges at the top (zone_complete_01 and level_end_01, top-left). The large dark slab at the tunnel end gets no lighting and looks flat-unlit next to the lit kit. The warm point light on the Professor in zone_complete_01 is the only lighting accent.

The kit pieces (perforated decks, rusty ring frames, crates) are hand-painted and use the palette (Deep Ocean Blue, Rust Brown, Station Amber stripes). But the end of the tunnel is a large untextured dark navy rectangle (key_carried_01, zone_complete_01, crab_defeated_01), which reads as a missing material or placeholder slab. The ground and water is a featureless flat blue plane, and the tunnel glass is plain light blue. Both are off-palette fills, not painted surfaces.

The HUD follows §9: only the N / T counter, plus KEY while carried, and the counter is legible. Landing surfaces have hazard-striped edges and a drop shadow is visible. Several things break the rules. The background is not desaturated: start_01 shows saturated cyan jellyfish tanks and a saturated blue jellyfish structure, and cyan is meant to be reserved for flies and Sprat. The flies are tiny at this camera distance. The Professor is small and in key_carried_01 sits against the dark slab with low contrast. The key glyph is a text label 'KEY', not a shaped glyph, so it relies on colour and text.

The delivered kit and characters fit the hand-painted closed-palette brief. The scene as composed does not. The flat blue plane, flat glass and dark slab at the tunnel end look unfinished. The background is saturated, not 30% desaturated. The camera framing departs from the authored follow. The main menu (SCN_MainMenu_Boot_menu_01) is a plain flat navy screen with text buttons and no art.

worst_defects.problem: A large untextured, unlit dark navy rectangle closes the end of the tunnel behind the Professor. It also appears in zone_complete_01, crab_defeated_01 and start_01. It reads as a missing material or placeholder slab and is the focal point of the corridor.
worst_defects.reference: style.md §8: hand-painted stylized 3D, kit-based environments; amber reserved for the key and door.
